item.title: 'Target is down': IDF releases cockpit footage of F-35 downing Iranian jet over Tehran | Watch
item.description: The dogfight marks the first known time an F-35 has downed an enemy aircraft and the first aerial kill by the Israeli Air Force since the late 1980s

item.title: Missile from Iran hits open area in central Israel, no injuries reported
item.description: The IDF said the number of missile launches from Iran appears to be declining, though authorities remain on alert for possible developments involving the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen

item.title: Over 3,000 Iranian soldiers and operatives killed since start of war, Israeli officials say
item.description: Officials say the air force has dropped about 5,500 munitions across Iran and carried out 12 major strike missions over Tehran, destroying missile sites, command centers and air defenses as part of a phased campaign with the United States

item.title: Israel targets Hamas figure in north Lebanon as Iranian launches trigger sirens in Israel
item.description: Strike on an apartment in the Beddawi refugee camp in Tripoli, reportedly aimed at a Hamas figure, as Iranian missile launches trigger explosions across central Israel and Israeli forces hit Hezbollah infrastructure in Beirut’s Dahieh district

item.title: Macron warns against Israeli ground move in Lebanon; Hezbollah leader: 'We will keep fighting'
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron called for preserving Lebanon’s territorial integrity while urging Hezbollah to 'immediately stop its attacks,' as the terror group’s leader said Hezbollah is fighting Israel independently and accused Israel of 'seeking expansion'

item.title: New wave of strikes hits Tehran; IDF says no Iran-Hezbollah coordination detected
item.description: Israeli jets strike Tehran again in 11th wave as IDF says 300 air defenses hit and denies coordination between Iran and Hezbollah attacks

item.title: IDF says it needs two weeks of military activity in Iran to hit 'thousands of targets'
item.description: US expected to achieve full air superiority in coming hours, according to senior Israeli officials; coming two weeks will focus on the 'systematic pounding of military targets' in combined US-Israeli effort

item.title: Iran 'justifies' firing on its neighbors: 'Israel and the US left us no choice'
item.description: Iranians are trying to appease neighboring countries after shooting at them, claiming it was self-defense: 'We respect your sovereignty'; Qatar responds: 'Trying to drag us into war'

item.title: Sirens in central Israel; Israeli jets strike Lebanon as US hits Iran targets
item.description: Sirens sound in central Israel amid suspected drone infiltration in Galilee as Israeli jets strike southern Lebanon; US says it has enough precision munitions for Iran campaign

item.title: Report: Israeli Air Force jets returning from Iran also attack Lebanon
item.description: The Israeli jets are attacking Iran and then taking advantage of the return flight to drop their remaining munitions in Lebanon on real-time targets, security sources tell ynet; in eastern Tehran, a large-scale attack on security headquarters of the Iranian regime has been com...
